subject: dxf: make api request metering more accurate by intercepting request call (#64402)
summary: Reviewed this commit (vs first parent) focusing on DDL add-index global sort/backfill paths and DXF metering integration. The change refactors global-sort DDL steps to create/pass a shared `ExternalStorage` (optionally wrapped via `recording.WithRequests`) and merges recorded HTTP request counts into subtask summaries and metering recorder; it removes the prior callback-based request counting from external readers/writers and updates Lightning external-engine config to accept an `ExtStore` directly. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata/state handling, compatibility, or concurrency for the DDL/global-sort flows touched.
